mapper.sql: select s.id, s.skin_name, s.weapon_type_id, s.quality_id, s.image_url, s.description, s.min_price, s.status, s.create_time, s.update_time, wt.weapon_name, wt.weapon_category, sq.quality_name, (select wear_name from debuff_inventory i where i.skin_id = s.id limit 1) as wear_name from debuff_skin s left join debuff_weapon_type wt on s.weapon_type_id = wt.id left join debuff_skin_quality sq on s.quality_id = sq.id
mapper.select: select s.id as skin_id, s.skin_name, s.image_url, s.min_price, wt.weapon_name, wt.weapon_category, sq.quality_name, sq.quality_color, min(sl.price) as lowest_price, count(sl.id) as listing_count, (select sl2.id from debuff_skin_listing sl2 where sl2.skin_id = s.id and sl2.status = 0 order by sl2.price asc limit 1) as first_listing_id from debuff_skin s left join debuff_weapon_type wt on s.weapon_type_id = wt.id left join debuff_skin_quality sq on s.quality_id = sq.id left join debuff_skin_listing sl on s.id = sl.skin_id and sl.status = 0 where s.status = '0' group by s.id, s.skin_name, s.image_url, s.min_price, s.create_time, wt.weapon_name, wt.weapon_category, sq.quality_name, sq.quality_color having count(sl.id) > 0 order by listing_count desc, lowest_price asc limit #{limit}

select sl.id, sl.inventory_id, sl.seller_id, u.nick_name as seller_name, sl.price, sl.listing_time from debuff_skin_listing sl left join sys_user u on sl.seller_id = u.user_id where sl.skin_id = #{skinId} and sl.status = 0 order by sl.price asc, sl.listing_time asc

select date_format(record_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as record_date, avg_price, min_price, max_price, volume from debuff_price_history where skin_id = #{skinId} and record_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 30 day) order by record_date asc
mapper.insert: insert into debuff_skin (skin_name, weapon_type_id, quality_id, image_url, description, min_price, status) values (#{skinName}, #{weaponTypeId}, #{qualityId}, #{imageUrl}, #{description}, #{minPrice}, #{status})
mapper.delete:
delete from debuff_skin where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from debuff_inventory where skin_id = #{skinId}) as inventory_count, (select count(*) from debuff_buy_order where skin_id = #{skinId} and status in (0, 1)) as buy_order_count, (select count(*) from debuff_skin_listing where skin_id = #{skinId} and status in (0, 1)) as listing_count, 0 as order_count
